View cohort start dates View cohort start dates Portfolio Investors About Founder Login Founder Login Founder Login Pitch Us Pitch Us Pitch Us WHERE FOUNDERS GO FURTHER —FASTER Antler is a global early-stage VC firm that partners with exceptional founders from day zero to build impactful, scalable companies.

With offices in 27 cities—including New York , London , Berlin , Singapore , Tokyo , and Sydney —we back founders from all backgrounds, often from the very beginning of their journey, even before they have a team or idea.
PitchBook ranked Antler as the most active VC globally , Dealroom recognized the firm as the most active investor in AI startups .
Before Antler, Magnus co-founded Zalora, took the company from zero to Asia’s leading fashion e-commerce platform, and then helped scale Global Fashion Group across 26 markets.
Antler is the world’s most active early-stage investor, backing exceptional people at the very start of their journey — and supporting them from inception to scale.

Across 27 cities worldwide—including New York, San Francisco, London, Berlin, Bangalore, Singapore, Seoul, and Sydney—the firm helps founders remove the barriers to building by connecting them with world-class peers, validating business models, and providing initial capital.
To date, Antler has backed more than 2,000 startups globally, including Airalo, Lovable, Peec.AI, Reebelo, Wrtn, and Benjamin.
For founders who go on to build breakout companies, Antler Elevate—the $285M emerging growth fund—invests beyond the early stages, managed through offices in London, Singapore, and New York.

EXPAND BIO Lavanya Indralingam LinkedIn profile (opens in new tab) LinkedIn profile (opens in new tab) Partner, Head of Global Operations Spokesperson Lavanya leads Antler’s global operations, working with early-stage fund partners and local teams across markets to drive fund performance and operational efficiency.

Earlier at Antler, she led scouting and selection in the Nordics, played a key role in integrating operations across the region, and served on the Nordic Investment Committee. ‍ Before Antler, Lavanya worked at Katapult VC, a global early-stage impact fund, and was an early operator at a data analytics startup.

She also brings over a decade of experience in strategic communications and corporate advisory across Asia, Europe and North America, working with senior leaders across financial services and enterprise technology.
As the Executive Officer of TechSydney, he led Sydney’s premier technology industry organization.
